condition: When a tz-aware Datetime falls in a period where the zone's UTC offset includes seconds (e.g. historical LMT, or Africa/Monrovia before 1972), write_csv/write_ndjson/write_json round the offset to whole minutes, so the written timestamp can be up to 30 s off.
workaround: Convert the column to UTC with dt.convert_time_zone("UTC") before writing, or format it yourself with dt.to_string("%FT%T%::z").
